title: Access-structure rule table (ISO 14122-2/3/4, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.23/25/28/29) as llull would load it
units: mm, N, degrees unless the field name says otherwise; imperial originals kept in `original`
note: Values transcribed from search-engine extracts of the regulation / standard text and concordant secondary extracts (see ../sources.md). Paywalled ISO text was not read in full; each row names its grade. Only grade A rows gate pass/fail; B rows produce warnings with code *_UNVERIFIED_RULE; C rows are not loaded.

rules.quantity: rung pitch, centreline to centreline
fixed ladder rung clear width (before ladder safety system)
perpendicular clearance rung centreline to nearest permanent object behind
side-rail / grab-bar extension above access level
fixed ladder extending above lower level: fall protection required above
rules.detail: ladders installed on or after 2018-11-19: personal fall arrest or ladder safety system (cage/well alone not acceptable); existing caged ladders allowed until 2036-11-18 (repeal of that date proposed 2026-04-06, status open)

rules.quantity: landing platform interval, caged / well ladder sections (sections offset)
rest platform interval, ladder with ladder safety system / PFAS
standard stair riser height
standard stair tread depth
standard stair angle from horizontal
standard stair width between vertical barriers
landing width >= stair width; landing depth
riser heights and tread depths uniform between landings
guardrail top-edge height above walking-working surface
rules.original: 42 in ± 3 in; may exceed 45 in if all other criteria met

rules.quantity: midrail midway between top edge and surface (no wall/parapet >= 21 in); intermediate openings
top-rail test force, downward or outward within 2 in of top edge
top edge not below this height under the 200 lbf downward test
midrail / screen test force
toeboard vertical height
rung pitch, uniform over the flight
clear width between stiles
fall-protection device (cage or guided fall arrester) required from this overall falling height
height of the lowest cage hoop above the departure area
spacing between cage hoops
inside cage diameter / depth
maximum single-flight height before a rest / landing platform (staggered flights)
rules.note: sources disagree on the trigger (6 m flights vs rest platforms every 6 m above 10 m); not loaded as a gate

rules.quantity: stile / handrail extension above arrival level
g + 2h (going + 2 x rise)
headroom above the pitch line / tread nosings
stair clear width (preferred 800, 1000 when people routinely cross)
flight rise before a landing
guard-rail minimum height
clear space handrail-knee rail and knee rail-toe plate
toe-plate minimum height
toe-plate gap to walking level / platform edge
distance between guard-rail post axes
rules.note: commonly quoted, not confirmed by two extracts; llull uses postSpacing as an explicit param with this as a named default

rules.quantity: working platform / walkway clear width (600 occasional use)
headroom over a platform / walkway
